model: gpt-6-astra through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/responses endpoint, reasoning.effort=high
turn_rule: A turn is kept iff (a) mean overall score over 2 samples >= A2_VALUE_TH (default 7, following the score threshold used by SWE-Prime for segment masking), (b) neither sample lists the turn in risky_turns (risk >= 3), and (c) no deterministic mechanism flag fires. Setting A2_VALUE_TH=0 gives the risk-only veto arm.
eligibility: Trajectory kept iff its final best_route was audited VALID by the frozen route audit (SUSPECT/FAKE/ERROR excluded) and the trajectory fits the 131072-token context.
disclosure: The selector sees hindsight (the final route plus judge notes). The prompt was tuned on train-side trajectories with non-expert review; it is not an expert label, and dev/test targets were never used.
notes: All digests above are the SHA-256 of the files as shipped in this directory; compact_traj.py and mech_flags_v1.py live under assemble/, and prompt_v4.txt / seg_select.py under selector/.
